method.sanctions: Programs on the OFAC page named after a country, mapped by hand. Worldwide topic programs are left out. UN sanctions were not added because the UN page could not be read.

caveats: Facts about countries, not findings about companies.
No entry does not mean no risk.
All sources are U.S. government sources.
